'''Fire''' can refer to the following:

==[[Weave]]s==
*[[Five Powers|Fire]] - one of the five flows of the [[One Power]].
*[[Arrows of Fire]] - an intricate weave of the Power.
*[[Blossoms of Fire]] - a combat weave of the Power.
*[[Fire ball]] - a simple weave of the Power.
*[[Spinning Earthfire]] - a weave of the Power from the [[Age of Legends]].

==Books and chapters==
*''[[The Fires of Heaven]]'' - the fifth book of ''[[The Wheel of Time]]'' series.
*''[[The Dragon Reborn/Chapter 37|Fires in Cairhien]]'' - the thirty-seventh chapter of ''[[The Dragon Reborn]]''.
*''[[The Shadow Rising/Chapter 7|Playing with Fire]]'' - the seventh chapter of ''[[The Shadow Rising]]''.
*''[[Lord of Chaos/Chapter 29|Fire and Spirit]]'' - the twenty-ninth chapter of ''[[Lord of Chaos]]''.

==Others==
*[[Defender of the Wall of First Fires]] - a title of [[Lan Mandragoran]].
*[[Great Fire of Sohima]] - a disaster on the [[Seanchan]] [[Seanchan (continent)|continet]].
*''[[Hearts of Flame]]'' - a book of love stories.
*''[[Meditations on the Kindling Flame]]'' - a book on the history of the [[Amyrlin Seat]]s.
*[[Wildfire]] - a she-[[wolf]] pack leader.
